Reference / http/target

http/target#

Request targets (RFC 9112 §3.2): the four forms of the second word of a request line.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let target = ParsedRequestTarget(origin: "/search?q=okkama", method: Method.get).target();
target.kind();                       // RequestTargetKind.origin
target.path();                       // "/search"
target.query() else "";              // "q=okkama"

OriginTarget(path: "/", query: Maybe<string>.none);
AbsoluteTarget(ParsedUrl("http://example.com/").parts());   // to a proxy
AuthorityTarget(ParsedUrl("//example.com:443").parts());   // CONNECT
AsteriskTarget();                                           // OPTIONS *

Description#

Request targets (RFC 9112 §3.2): the four forms of the second word of a request line.

Only CONNECT takes the authority form and only OPTIONS the asterisk form. Asking a target for a part its form does not have is WrongRequestTargetKind.
